{{Quote|Another classic sandwich, prepared just the way you'd get it back home, with crisp nuna bacon, Revwien lettuce and topato. Served on toasted or therm&ndash;zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Besh-Leth-Trill sandwich|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Besh-Leth-Trill sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] that consisted of crispy [[nuna bacon]], [[Revwien lettuce]], and [[Topato/Legends|topatos]], all served on toasted or thermo&ndash;zapped [[pseudograin bread]]. The sandwich was sold at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 5.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of its [[Foodstuff/Legends|lunch]] favorites<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Besh-Leth-Trill sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" /> Besh-Leth-Trill translates from [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] to B-L-T,<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> a real&ndash;world [[Wikipedia:Sandwich|sandwich]] that consisted of [[Wikipedia:Bacon|bacon]], [[Wikipedia:Lettuce|lettuce]], and [[Wikipedia:Tomato|tomato]].<ref name="BLT">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/BLT|text=BLT|works=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20260206182528}}</ref>
